description: This file defines a React component named AddHabitModal used for adding new habits in a habit-tracking application. It includes state management, event handling, form submission, and UI rendering with styling.

methods.name: AddHabitModal
methods.description: React functional component for a modal dialog that allows users to add a new habit, with visual effects, form handling, and event management.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the input state and error message to initial blank state.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission to create a new habit via the createHabit external method, manages loading and error states, and triggers callbacks.
